answer: Proof of Burn (PoB) serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism for agent networks. By requiring agents to provably destroy native tokens, the protocol creates a hard economic cost for every identity, preventing an attacker from spawning a spiral of fake nodes. As the system reaches a nadir of trust, the cost of entry acts like a walnut shell protecting the core network integrity from dilution, forcing adversaries to exhaust real capital instead of exploiting zero-cost account generation.
